_config.stream_algorithm: numpy.SeedSequence(8 entropy uint32 words, HRLD domain, frame, component); NOT keyed by rho or snr

receiver.logloss: mean log2(1+exp(-(1-2b)L)) over 2048 coded bits, L=log P0/P1

environment.torch_binding_authority: receiver context build; verified before first receiver run

pairing: all rows of each frame (population: each snr cell frame) share (channel_seed, physical_gains_sha256, info_sha256, noise_sha256)
